record.name: Vietnam
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The AI Law in force since March 2026 makes the science ministry the AI regulator and relies on self-assessment or certified conformity assessment for high-risk systems.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Science and Technology (MOST)
related_bodies.role: It manages AI for the state under the 2025 AI Law. It runs the national AI portal for risk notifications and incident reports.
